Invoices · free, in your browser

Free invoice generator with templates and PDF

Write an invoice, issue it with the next number, and download a PDF or print it. Invoices keeps your customers, invoices and payments in this browser, with no account to make.

Make an invoice

How to do it

  1. Choose New invoice, then pick a customer or add one with New customer.
  2. Choose Add line for each item: description, Qty, Unit price, Tax % and Discount %. The totals show the subtotal, the tax at each rate and the total.
  3. Set the invoice date and the due date (it starts at the date plus your payment terms), add any notes, and Save.
  4. Choose Issue… to give the invoice its number (INV-0001, then INV-0002 and on, with no gaps).
  5. Choose Export PDF for an A4 file in the invoice's template, or Preview / print to print it.
  6. When the customer pays, choose Record payment… A part payment leaves the rest owing; the last one marks it Paid.

Five templates are built in: classic, modern, minimal, bold header and side bar. Your company name, address and tax number come from the company profile in Admin and appear on every invoice and PDF.

Your data is kept in this browser on this device. Download a full backup from the Data tab now and then, and restore it on another computer if you move.

Your files stay on this device: Invoices runs in your browser, with no upload, no account and no watermark.

Questions

Is it really free, with no account?

Yes. Invoices runs in your browser. There is no sign-up, no limit on the number of invoices, and no watermark on the PDF.

Where are my invoices stored?

In this browser on this device, in the same local store as the other ITpris business apps. Nothing is sent to a server. Use Download full backup to keep a copy.

Can I change an invoice after it is issued?

No: an issued invoice is read only, as books need. While it has no payments you can void it (the number stays used), or take money back with a credit note.

Can I start from an order or a quote?

Yes. From an order… makes a draft from a confirmed or fulfilled order in Orders, and an accepted quote in Quotes becomes a draft invoice in one click.
